problems: The film runs only 0.5 s. Nobody scrolling past can take in anything that short, and the storyboard frames are all but identical.

Storyboard frames 1-11 and the full-size frames at 25% and 50% are almost entirely black. At most there is a faint lit strip or a single orange speck (frame 5). You cannot see an island, the sea or a sun.

The caption says the sun was sunk 'into the sea' and lit the island 'from underneath', but no frame shows water, a sun below the surface, or light coming up from below. The caption's whole premise never appears in the pictures.

Between storyboard frames 11 and 12 there is a hard jump from near-black to a different camera view: dim trees against a dark-blue sky (the full-size 75% frame). It looks like a cut or a render glitch, not something happening in the world.

The last frames (12-16, and the 75% frame) look like an ordinary dim night scene lit from above and the side. Nothing in them is lit from below, so they don't even show the failure the caption describes.
As a failure post it doesn't read as a failure either. A black screen gives no sign that something was tried and the tracer missed it; it just looks like a broken or empty video.
posts.critique: This is half a second of near-black frames followed by an abrupt cut to a dim night grove. The sun in the sea and the light from underneath that the caption describes never appear, so the post neither shows the idea nor reads as a failure of it.
